title: The Words — Sc058: Darwin backview whip-turn close-up (17 frames)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: How to stage a whip-turn reaction close-up with almost nothing: one backview puppet, one face-comp performance, one cropped background. The scene is 17 frames and a single scene-level placement - Darwin seen from behind for the first 5 frames (a dedicated GB200_DARWIN_PUPPET_BACKVIEW_v001), then turned to camera where the entire performance is face comps (1702 face kf vs 271 body kf in the census): closed-eye grin, open-mouth shock, blushing smile. The background is not repainted for the close-up - it is a crop (GB214_WORDS_SC057_LO_BG_crop.jpg) of the Sc057 wide hallway plate, so the close-up inherits the wide shot's photographic corridor for free.
notes: Solo Darwin extreme close-up: frames 1-5 are the BACK of his head (GB200_DARWIN_PUPPET_BACKVIEW_v001 on the 'dwn' layer), then he whips round to face camera - huge closed-eye grin (f7), open-mouth reaction (f9-11), pleased blushing smile (f13-17).

One scene-level puppet placement and one background for all 17 frames: BG is GB214_WORDS_SC057_LO_BG_crop.jpg, a crop of the Sc057 hallway plate - the close-up is achieved by cropping the wide scene's background, not with a new painting.
Face system carries everything: face comps hold 1702 kf vs 271 body-puppet kf in the library census (GB200_DRW_HEADCOMP alone up to 376 kf).
